findings.issue: כָּל with plural participle יֹשְׁבֵי licenses all the inhabitants; singular habitante keeps the same universal only as a distributive.
H4906 and H6754 are different lemmas; both become imágenes, so the first noun is flattened into the second.

notes: 2mp as ustedes; piel אבד twice as destruyan; hiphil שמד as exterminen; 3mp suffixes kept.
